# LoVisual

> LoVisual is a free Fabric mod for Minecraft with 80+ visual modules: wings, particles, a custom HUD, weather and 18 built-in themes. It is a visual mod, not a cheat client. This site hosts the download, a browser theme editor, a showcase of community configs and account tools. The site is available in Russian and English.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://visual.loki-code.dev/): what the mod does, live ClickGui and HUD demos
- [Download](https://visual.loki-code.dev/download): the mod jar and release notes
- [Themes](https://visual.loki-code.dev/themes): edit and preview ClickGui themes in the browser
- [Showcase](https://visual.loki-code.dev/showcase): configs and themes published by players

## Notes for crawlers

- [Sitemap](https://visual.loki-code.dev/sitemap.xml): list of public pages
- Account pages (`/account`, `/configs`, `/link`) require a login and contain nothing public.
